shield.topic: 斜邊上的高：面積的兩種算法
shield.stem: 如圖，直角三角形的兩股長是 $a$、$b$，斜邊長是 $c$，斜邊上的高是 $h$。下列哪一個正確？
shield.figure: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 230" width="400" height="230"><rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff"/><polygon points="52.1,186.0 347.9,186.0 241.4,44.0" fill="#fde3cf" stroke="#1b1b1b" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/><line x1="241.4" y1="44.0" x2="241.4" y2="186.0" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/><polyline points="234.2,49.4 239.6,56.6 246.8,51.2" fill="none" stroke="#1b1b1b" stroke-width="1.3"/><polyline points="248.4,186.0 248.4,179.0 241.4,179.0" fill="none" stroke="#1b1b1b" stroke-width="1.3"/><text stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" paint-order="stroke" x="126.0" y="205.0" font-family="'Noto Sans TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1b1b1b" font-weight="600">c</text><text stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" paint-order="stroke" x="138.3" y="108.8" font-family="'Noto Sans TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1b1b1b" font-weight="600">b</text><text stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" paint-order="stroke" x="301.9" y="114.6" font-family="'Noto Sans TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="start" fill="#1b1b1b" font-weight="600">a</text><text stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" paint-order="stroke" x="232.4" y="120.0" font-family="'Noto Sans TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="end" fill="#c0392b" font-weight="600">h</text></svg>
shield.explanation: 面積 $=\dfrac{1}{2}ab=\dfrac{1}{2}ch$，所以 $ch=ab$，$h=\dfrac{ab}{c}$（兩股乘積 ÷ 斜邊）。

shield.topic: 斜邊上的高：面積的兩種算法
shield.stem: 如圖，$\triangle ABC$ 中 $\angle C=90^\circ$，$h$ 是斜邊 $\overline{AB}$ 上的高。下列哪一個正確？
shield.figure: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 230" width="400" height="230"><rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff"/><polygon points="52.1,186.0 347.9,186.0 241.4,44.0" fill="#fde3cf" stroke="#1b1b1b" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/><line x1="241.4" y1="44.0" x2="241.4" y2="186.0" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/><polyline points="234.2,49.4 239.6,56.6 246.8,51.2" fill="none" stroke="#1b1b1b" stroke-width="1.3"/><polyline points="248.4,186.0 248.4,179.0 241.4,179.0" fill="none" stroke="#1b1b1b" stroke-width="1.3"/><text stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" paint-order="stroke" x="232.4" y="120.0" font-family="'Noto Sans TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="end" fill="#c0392b" font-weight="600">h</text><text stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" paint-order="stroke" x="38.7" y="198.7" font-family="'Times New Roman',Times,serif" font-style="italic" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1b1b1b">A</text><text stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" paint-order="stroke" x="361.3" y="198.7" font-family="'Times New Roman',Times,serif" font-style="italic" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1b1b1b">B</text><text stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" paint-order="stroke" x="241.4" y="35.0" font-family="'Times New Roman',Times,serif" font-style="italic" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1b1b1b">C</text></svg>
shield.explanation: 同一個三角形的面積：$\dfrac{1}{2}\times\overline{AC}\times\overline{BC}=\dfrac{1}{2}\times\overline{AB}\times h$，兩邊同乘 2 得 $\overline{AC}\times\overline{BC}=\overline{AB}\times h$。

shield.stem: 如圖，坐標平面上 $A(x_1,y_1)$、$B(x_2,y_2)$ 兩點的距離 $\overline{AB}=$？
shield.figure: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 360 230" width="360" height="230"><rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff"/><polygon points="44.0,47.0 316.0,183.0 44.0,183.0" fill="#fde3cf" stroke="#1b1b1b" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/><polyline points="44.0,175.0 52.0,175.0 52.0,183.0" fill="none" stroke="#1b1b1b" stroke-width="1.3"/><text stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" paint-order="stroke" x="53.1" y="31.6" font-family="'Noto Sans TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1b1b1b">A(x₁, y₁)</text><text stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" paint-order="stroke" x="316.0" y="215.2" font-family="'Noto Sans TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1b1b1b">B(x₂, y₂)</text><text stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" paint-order="stroke" x="34.9" y="215.2" font-family="'Noto Sans TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1b1b1b">C(x₁, y₂)</text><circle cx="44.0" cy="47.0" r="3.6" fill="#1b1b1b"/><circle cx="316.0" cy="183.0" r="3.6" fill="#1b1b1b"/><circle cx="44.0" cy="183.0" r="3.6" fill="#1b1b1b"/></svg>
shield.explanation: 過 $A$、$B$ 作鉛垂線與水平線交於 $C$：兩股是 $|x_2-x_1|$、$|y_2-y_1|$，$\overline{AB}$ 是斜邊，所以 $\overline{AB}=\sqrt{(x_2-x_1)^2+(y_2-y_1)^2}$。

shield.stem: 如圖，坐標平面上 $P(a,b)$、$Q(c,d)$ 兩點的距離 $\overline{PQ}=$？

shield.explanation: $x$ 坐標的差是 $c-a$，$y$ 坐標的差是 $d-b$：$\overline{PQ}=\sqrt{(c-a)^2+(d-b)^2}$。$a-b$ 是同一點的 $x$、$y$ 坐標相減，沒有意義。

shield.stem: 如圖，坐標平面上 $A(x_1,y_1)$、$B(x_2,y_2)$ 兩點的距離 $\overline{AB}=$？

shield.explanation: 過 $A$、$B$ 作鉛垂線與水平線交於 $C$：兩股是 $|x_2-x_1|$、$|y_2-y_1|$，$\overline{AB}$ 是斜邊，所以 $\overline{AB}=\sqrt{(x_2-x_1)^2+(y_2-y_1)^2}$。

analysis.stem:
小華求兩股為 $6$、$8$ 的直角三角形斜邊，寫了：
① $c^2=6^2+8^2=100$
② $c=6+8=14$
哪一步開始錯了？
analysis.explanation: 畢氏定理求出 $c^2$ 後要開根號，不是把兩股相加。正確：$c=\sqrt{100}$$=10$。
analysis.hint: 看第②步：由平方得到長度時要開根號。
